identity.name: Endeavour Centre Seconds Concept
identity.one_liner: A deliberately unbranded dress watch, shown at SIHH 2016 with no logo or wordmark on a fumé dial to argue that the design should stand on its own.

narrative.story: H. Moser & Cie showed the Concept version of the Endeavour Centre Seconds at SIHH 2016 with the brand's name, logo, and every printed word removed from the dial, leaving only hands over a fumé sunburst finish. The move was explicitly a statement about branding in watchmaking, made by a manufacture small enough to gamble a flagship launch on the argument that a well-made dial doesn't need a name on it to be recognized.
narrative.collector_notes: Dial color is the primary collectible variable across Concept-line Centre Seconds pieces; because there is no branding on the dial to distinguish limited runs from standard production, buyers verify case-back engravings and documentation rather than dial text.
